name: InterContinental Porto-Palacio das Cardosas
positioning: Hotel in the 18th-century Palácio das Cardosas, facing Praça da Liberdade and overlooking Avenida dos Aliados in the heart of Porto
best_for: Travelers who want to explore Porto's historic centre on foot
Families wanting suites or connecting rooms in the city centre

facts.text: The hotel is housed in the Palácio das Cardosas, an 18th-century building.
The hotel overlooks Avenida dos Aliados in the heart of Porto.
São Bento Station, the Clérigos Tower, Livraria Lello and the Ribeira are a few minutes' walk from the hotel.
Rooms have a clean, contemporary look, with detailed crown molding and ceiling-height mirrors hinting at the building's history.
Deluxe rooms have full marble bathrooms with both a bathtub and a shower.
Classic rooms may include a city-centre view or a cathedral view.
Suite types include a Two Storey Suite, a Prestige Suite and a Panoramic Suite.
Astória Restaurant serves typical Portuguese cuisine with a contemporary touch and has a view over Praça da Liberdade.
The wellness centre offers massages and sauna sessions.
The hotel holds Green Key certification.
The hotel offers family accommodation, including spacious suites and connecting rooms.

highlights.text: The hotel faces Praça da Liberdade, Porto's Belle Époque main square.
The lobby has crystal chandeliers and marble floors.
Deluxe rooms overlook the Pátio das Cardosas, a quiet pedestrian square.
Bar das Cardosas is styled as an English library and offers a wide range of Port wines and cocktails, as well as afternoon tea.

considerations.text: Parking is in a covered car park next to the hotel, at a special rate for guests.
Only small dogs and cats are accepted, subject to hotel approval.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning and central location.
